description: Independent end-of-workload verification, run by the harness through psql after the client exits. Per-case checks are executed by the client through its own driver immediately after each case; these invariants are the second, driver-independent path. They catch silent data loss, duplicate rows, broken foreign keys, negative stock and leaked connections.

insert.sql: SELECT count(*)::bigint, count(DISTINCT id)::bigint FROM bench_writes

update.sql: SELECT payload FROM bench_writes WHERE id = 1

join.sql: SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM orders o LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.id IS NULL

transactions.sql: SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM bench_writes b LEFT JOIN bench_writes c ON c.id = b.id AND c.id <> b.id WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL

concurrency.sql: SELECT count(*)::bigint, count(DISTINCT id)::bigint FROM bench_writes

connections.sql: SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = 'bench'

application.sql: SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM products WHERE stock < 0
SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM orders o LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.id IS NULL
SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id IS NULL
